Sliding out a merged branch — details

## Notes
\

\
* merging top-most PR requires 2 changes
\
    * remove merged branch from git-machete state
\
    * implied: retarget PR2 to `main`
\
* `git machete slide-out` and `git machete traverse` take care of this efficiently
\
* when GitHub merges PR1 and deletes the source branch, PR2 will automatically get retargeted to main (usually voiding any granted approval)
\
    * improved GitHub support for stacked PRs under development
